chunks.title: BlackRock (Climate Infrastructure & Transition Investing) (BlackRock Climate Infra) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: BlackRock (Climate Infrastructure & Transition Investing) is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in United States. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Active delegation at COP31 Antalya participating in energy transition infrastructure & private capital dialogues. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Global Climate Infrastructure & Energy Transition institutional funds (including emerging markets blended Climate Finance Partnership). Source verification: https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/13/cop31-companies-and-groups-linked-to-fossil-fuels-delegations.

chunks.title: BlackRock Climate Infra Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: BlackRock (Climate Infrastructure & Transition Investing) provides the following climate financing instruments: Infrastructure Equity, Blended Transition Equity (CFP), Project Equity, Long-Term Infrastructure Debt. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 25,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Large Corporate, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise, Infrastructure Developer.

chunks.title: BlackRock Climate Infra Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by BlackRock (Climate Infrastructure & Transition Investing): Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Electrification & Grid, Industrial Decarbonization, Clean Transport, Carbon Capture & Storage. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, Emerging Markets, Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: BlackRock Climate Infra Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete BlackRock Climate Infra's application form: Contracted long-term cash flows (PPAs / offtake agreements); Institutional-scale capex & commercial IRR benchmarks; Comprehensive technical, legal & ESG due diligence; Proven management / EPC track record. Explicit exclusion rules: Unbankable early-R&D ventures without commercial path; Thermal coal. Official application portal: https://www.blackrock.com/institutions/en-us/capabilities/alternatives/infrastructure.

chunks.title: BlackRock Climate Infra Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: BlackRock (Climate Infrastructure & Transition Investing) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
